blocks.explanation:
Yahan \(\ln x\) do dafa aaya hai aur saath mein \(\frac{1}{x}\) bhi, jo \(\ln x\) ka derivative hai. To pehla qadam: \(u = \ln x\), \(du = \frac{dx}{x}\).
Integral \(\int u\tan^{-1}u\,du\) ban jata hai: algebraic \(\times\) inverse trigonometric.
ILATE: I (inverse) sab se pehle, is liye \(\tan^{-1}u\) first aur \(u\) second.
Parts ke baad \(\int \frac{u^2}{1+u^2}\,du\) aayega; is ko \(1 - \frac{1}{1+u^2}\) likh kar aasaan karenge.
Aakhir mein \(u = \ln x\) wapas.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{\ln x\tan^{-1}(\ln x)}{x}\,dx\), \(x > 0\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: \(u = \ln x\); phir \(\int u\tan^{-1}u\,du\) parts se, \(\tan^{-1}u\) first.

Substitution
\[u = \ln x \Rightarrow du = \dfrac{1}{x}\,dx\]
\[= \int u\tan^{-1}u\,du\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{x}\,dx\) bilkul \(du\) hai; baqi \(\ln x\tan^{-1}(\ln x)\) ban gaya \(u\tan^{-1}u\).

Parts lagayein
\[= \dfrac{u^2}{2}\tan^{-1}u - \int \dfrac{u^2}{2}\cdot\dfrac{1}{1+u^2}\,du\]
Kyun: \(u\) ka integral \(\frac{u^2}{2}\) aur \(\tan^{-1}u\) ka derivative \(\frac{1}{1+u^2}\).

Fraction ko torein
\[\dfrac{u^2}{1+u^2} = 1 - \dfrac{1}{1+u^2}\]
\[\int \dfrac{u^2}{1+u^2}\,du = u - \tan^{-1}u\]
Kyun: numerator mein 1 jama aur minus: \(u^2 = (1 + u^2) - 1\). Phir \(\int \frac{du}{1+u^2} = \tan^{-1}u\).
Dhyan dein: \(\int \frac{u^2}{1+u^2}\,du\) ko \(\ln(1 + u^2)\) likh dena ghalat hai; upar \(u^2\) hai, \(2u\) nahi.

Jor dein
\[= \dfrac{u^2}{2}\tan^{-1}u - \dfrac{u}{2} + \dfrac{1}{2}\tan^{-1}u + c\]
Kyun: \(-\frac{1}{2}\) ko \((u - \tan^{-1}u)\) ke dono terms se zarb kiya.

Wapas \(x\) mein
\[= \dfrac{(\ln x)^2\tan^{-1}(\ln x)}{2} - \dfrac{\ln x}{2}\]
\[\quad + \dfrac{\tan^{-1}(\ln x)}{2} + c\]
Kyun: \(u = \ln x\) wapas rakha.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{du}(\ldots) = u\tan^{-1}u + \dfrac{u^2}{2(1+u^2)} - \dfrac{1}{2} + \dfrac{1}{2(1+u^2)}\]
\[= u\tan^{-1}u + \dfrac{1 + u^2}{2(1 + u^2)} - \dfrac{1}{2} = u\tan^{-1}u\]
Kyun: faltu terms ka jama zero ho gaya; \(u\tan^{-1}u\) bacha, jo substitution ke baad ka integrand hai.
